subject: science
concept: Understanding day and night as caused by Earth's rotation
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Earth and Space Science Disciplinary Core Ideas — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student rotates a virtual globe with a light source to observe day/night forming on different sides
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a pictured globe position to whether it's day or night in a marked location
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, why day and night happen

misconception_flags: believes the sun moves around the Earth rather than the Earth rotating

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
